text_block_list.text:
Worried about Manhattan Cafe not showing 
up for training, I searched for her, only 
to find her waving her hand at empty 
space...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......Goodbye. ...Please go straight home 
without stopping anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Trainer-san... There was a lost 
child, so I was showing them the 
way............

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, shall we head off to 
training...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...We only spoke for a few seconds, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"......No, it has nothing to do with that, 
does it? I'm sorry... I'll be more careful 
from now on......"

She seems deeply remorseful. Plus, she 
promised to be careful, so I decide not to 
pry any further...
